title: Explain and defend a technical trade-off (B2)
summary: Khuyến nghị một phương án kỹ thuật, làm rõ hệ quả và sửa lại lời giải thích chưa rõ.

sections.title: Decision context
sections.content: Synthetic training artifact — non-production. Synchronous validation gives an immediate answer but adds up to 900 ms at peak. A queued worker keeps requests fast and retries transient failures, but final status may take two minutes. The release needs predictable request latency; compliance requires validation before publication.

vocabulary.technicalMeaning: Điều kiện bắt buộc giới hạn các lựa chọn.
vocabulary.commonMistake: Nhấn âm tiết thứ hai: con-STRAINT.

vocabulary.technicalMeaning: Thời gian chờ từ lúc gửi yêu cầu đến lúc nhận phản hồi.
vocabulary.example: The new design reduces latency by forty percent.

vocabulary.technicalMeaning: Mọi người đọc dữ liệu thấy cùng một giá trị.
vocabulary.example: We accept weaker consistency for speed.
vocabulary.commonMistake: Nhấn âm tiết thứ hai: con-SIS-ten-cy.

vocabulary.technicalMeaning: Công sức hoặc tài nguyên thêm để duy trì giải pháp.
vocabulary.example: A new service adds operational overhead.

vocabulary.technicalMeaning: Trạng thái cho biết yêu cầu đã được nhận nhưng chưa xử lý xong.
vocabulary.example: The client sees a pending state until validation succeeds.
vocabulary.commonMistake: Pending là tính từ chỉ trạng thái chưa xong: a pending state, không phải a pend state.

expressions.phrase: I recommend ___ because ___ is the deciding factor.
expressions.meaning: Nêu một khuyến nghị gắn với yếu tố quyết định.
expressions.example: I recommend the queued worker because predictable latency is the deciding factor.

expressions.phrase: The benefit is ___; the cost is ___.
expressions.meaning: Nêu rõ cả hai mặt của một sự đánh đổi.
expressions.example: The benefit is predictable request latency; the cost is delayed final status.

expressions.meaning: Nối rủi ro chính với một hành động hợp lý.
expressions.example: We can mitigate delayed status by showing a clear pending state.
alternatives: To reduce this risk, I would ___.

sections.title: Locate and defend the deciding constraint

exercises.question: Which requirement favors the queued worker?
exercises.explanation: Hàng đợi đưa độ trễ của bước xác thực ra khỏi đường xử lý yêu cầu, còn việc xuất bản vẫn bị chặn cho đến khi xác thực xong.

exercises.question: Which statement preserves the latency evidence precisely?
options: Synchronous validation adds up to 900 ms at peak.
Synchronous validation always adds exactly 900 ms.
The queued worker always finishes within 900 ms.
correctAnswer: Synchronous validation adds up to 900 ms at peak.
exercises.explanation: "Up to" là giới hạn trên trong bằng chứng, không phải độ trễ được đảm bảo cho mọi yêu cầu.

exercises.question: Which mitigation addresses delayed final status without violating compliance?
options: Show a pending state and block publication until validation succeeds.
Display success immediately and validate after publication.
Remove validation from peak traffic, then publish every request straight away.
correctAnswer: Show a pending state and block publication until validation succeeds.
exercises.explanation: Trạng thái chờ báo cho người dùng biết về độ trễ, còn việc chặn xuất bản giữ đúng yêu cầu tuân thủ đã nêu.

exercises.question: Sửa lỗi: câu "We can mitigate the risk with adding a retry." dùng sai một từ. Điền từ đúng thay cho "with".
Sắp xếp một lập luận trade-off.
options: we can mitigate it by showing a pending state
the cost is delayed final status
the benefit is predictable request latency
correctAnswer: the benefit is predictable request latency
the cost is delayed final status
we can mitigate it by showing a pending state

exercises.explanation: Ôn lại các từ đã học trong bài này.

Điền từ còn thiếu (độ trễ): The new design reduces ___ by forty percent.

performanceTask.title: Recommend and defend one design
performanceTask.scenario: Explain an architecture recommendation to engineers and a product manager.
performanceTask.baselinePrompt: In 60–90 seconds, use the decision evidence shown here and state the constraint, recommendation, cost and mitigation before you see the model or the chunks.
performanceTask.performancePrompt: In English, speak for 60–90 seconds: frame the decision, recommend one option, connect the benefit and cost to constraints, then mitigate the main risk.
performanceTask.modelResponse: I recommend the queued worker because predictable request latency is the deciding factor for this release. The synchronous option gives an immediate answer, but it adds up to nine hundred milliseconds at peak. That makes request latency hard to predict. By contrast, the queue keeps the request fast and supports retries for transient failures. The main cost is that the final status can take up to two minutes, so acceptance must not look like completion. Compliance also requires validation before publication, so nothing is published until validation succeeds. I would mitigate the delay by showing a clear pending state while validation is still running. For this release, that balance protects predictable latency and the validation requirement. If immediate final status became the deciding factor, we would need to revisit the choice.
performanceTask.retryPrompt: In 60–90 seconds, use the retry context, lead with one recommendation and connect each consequence to a named constraint.
performanceTask.transferPrompt: In 60–90 seconds, use the database context and make a new recommendation without looking at the model answer or the chunks.
performanceTask.reviewPrompt: In 60–90 seconds, use the build-versus-buy context and explain a fresh decision without looking at the model answer or the chunks.

artifacts.content: Synthetic training artifact — non-production. Sync: immediate status, up to 900 ms added latency at peak. Queue: fast request, retries, up to two-minute result. Constraint: predictable latency and validation before publication.

artifacts.content: Synthetic training artifact — non-production. Managed database costs $900/month and includes backups/on-call support. Self-hosted costs $250/month but needs about 12 engineer-hours/month. Constraint: two-person team and 24/7 recovery.

audio.text: The request stays fast, but the result is delayed.
I recommend the queued worker because latency is the deciding factor.
It retries failures; however, users wait for final status.
We can mitigate the wait by showing users a pending state.

If the product needs immediate status, we can revisit the decision.

audio.text: Let me put that more clearly: speed matters more than immediate status.

training.feedback: Let me put that more clearly signals repair.

audio.text: Sampling reduces storage costs, but rare events may be missed.
The deciding factor is incident visibility.
I would capture all errors and sample successful requests.

posttest.question: Mitigation là gì?
options: Capture every success and sample the errors
Keep critical evidence while limiting volume
Keep every log and ignore the storage volume
posttest.correctAnswer: Keep critical evidence while limiting volume
